notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
description:
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning Slimefoot and Squee and Ruthless Technomancer to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Ruthless Technomancer enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Ruthless Technomancer trigger, causing you to sacrifice Slimefoot and Squee and create three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
